candidates.change_summary: Remove the assert, so a zero-value deposit (which previously reverted) now succeeds.
Replace the accumulation `+=` with assignment `=`, so each deposit overwrites the balance instead of adding to it.
Insert an extra increment so each successful deposit credits one extra wei to the caller's balance.
Change msg.value to 1 so the balance is always credited by 1 wei regardless of the deposited amount.
Change the credit from `+=` to `-=`, causing deposits of positive value to revert via underflow (only zero-value deposits succeed).
Delete the statement `balances[msg.sender] -= amount;` so the sender's balance is never reduced after withdrawing.
Delete the `require(amount <= balances[msg.sender]);` guard so withdrawals are attempted even when they exceed the balance.
Change the require condition from `<=` to `<` so withdrawing the full balance now reverts.
Move the balance decrement before the transfer, so on reentrancy the balance is already zeroed before external funds are sent.
